text: Libram of Judgement teaches the Crusader Strike (paladin rune) rune for gloves. In order to use this item, you must first activate Seal of Righteousness (or another seal) and use Judgment#Classic against 10 enemies while the Libram is equipped.
Libram of Justice teaches the Hand of Reckoning (paladin rune) rune for gloves. In order to use this item, you must first kill 10 enemies stunned by Hammer of Justice while the Libram is equipped.

Libram of Blessings teaches the Hallowed Ground (paladin rune) rune for chest armor. In order to use this item, you must first cast Blessing of Might (or another Blessing) on 5 players while the Libram is equipped.

Libram of Deliverance teaches the Sacred Shield (paladin rune) rune for boots. In order to use this item, you must first use Blessing of Freedom to free 5 other players from movement impairing effects.

Light's Redoubt is a dawntower on the southern edge of Hallowfall. It serves as an airship dock for the Reckoning and fortification against Azj-Kahet in southwestern Hallowfall. Adventurers are directed here during The Final Front, in the final chapter of the Hallowfall storyline. The Light's Redoubt Descent skyriding race starts at just to the north, and the Mereldar Meander starts at further northwest. The redoubt is bordered by the Veneration Grounds to the northwest, Mereldar to the north, Beledar's Bounty to the northeast, and Livia's Patience and the Harrowing Depths downhill to the south.

Light's Blooming is a dawntower and max-level area in the center of the greater Light's Blooming farms of northeastern Hallowfall. On the farm, the Whirring Field is to the east, the Shadowgrove Vineyards are to the southeast, the Fungal Fields are to the south, Duskrise Acreage is to the southwest, and Hillhelm Stead is to the west. Off the farm, Isaec's Folly is to the northwest, and Stillstone Pond is to the northeast.
